facts.fact: SUNA reports Omdurman National Bank became the first bank in Sudan to activate the link, so customers inside and outside Sudan update their data on its digital channels with SudaPass verifying their identity.
facts.system: Omdurman National Bank digital channels (SudaPass link)

facts.fact: SUNA reports the Ministry of Digital Transformation, with the Central Bank of Sudan, is connecting the remaining banks one by one as each is technically ready, each to announce its own go-live.

systems.owner: Ministry of Digital Transformation and Communications
